units.source_text: 八坂神社管区有很多居民。

en.t: There are many residents in the parish district of Yasaka Shrine.

units.source_text: 即便宵山的庆典和十七日的彩车游行结束，后祭的庆典活动还会继续进行。

en.t: Even after the Yoiyama festivities and the float procession on the seventeenth are over, the events of the later festival continue.

units.source_text: 家家敞开大门，摆上屏风等装饰品。

en.t: Every household opens its front doors and displays folding screens and other ornaments.

units.source_text: 从前，还有的人家摆设早期浮世绘、狩野派、大和绘以及宗达画的一对屏风。

en.t: In the past, some houses also displayed pairs of folding screens with early ukiyo-e, Kano school paintings, Yamato-e, and works painted by Sotatsu.

units.source_text: 浮世绘珍品中，也有南蛮屏风，上面以雅致的京都风俗为背景，画了外国人的活动情形。

en.t: Among the rare ukiyo-e pieces were also Nanban screens, depicting the movements of foreigners against a background of elegant Kyoto customs.

units.source_text: 也就是说，表现了京都人旺盛的气势。

en.t: In other words, they expressed the vigorous spirit of the people of Kyoto.
